minutes.headline: Parks Commission reviewed the beach season and field fees; fee and Wallace Court lighting decisions were put off to the next meeting.
minutes.summary: The commission heard facility and recreation updates, a recap of the summer beach season (lifeguard shortage, pass sales shifting toward day passes), and a budget check-in on the parks and revolving accounts. Most of the meeting was a long discussion of raising field usage fees with Lunenburg youth baseball, ending with a request for usage and cost data before any decision. A vote on Wallace Court lighting was deferred until the full commission can attend, and prior minutes were approved with a correction.

public_comment.topic: A youth baseball league representative (Matt) described the league's contributions (dugouts, scoreboard, storage, porta-potties), player numbers and fees, and cautioned against large fee increases.

votes.motion: Approve the prior meeting's minutes with the amendment about who moved to adjourn.

budget_items.what_was_said: The facilities director said he checked with the accountant about why the revolving budget report looks odd.

budget_items.topic: Parks budget purchase orders and revolving account
budget_items.what_was_said: Money shown as spent on the regular parks budget is purchase orders, not cash out the door. The revolving account has not been carried forward to FY27 because FY26 is not closed.
Beach salaries were discussed against the town's contribution, with the revolving account covering the difference; this was a known arrangement.
Beach revenue came in higher than last year but short of covering the salary gap.
The contract rate runs through June 30 of FY27, with the beach at a set maintenance amount and no extra mowing.
The commission discussed raising field fees, the gap between fee revenue and maintenance cost, and fees at other towns. A figure was given for the gap between revenue and cost.
The league described its player fees and its in-kind investments in the fields.
Mowings run well beyond the contract count, charged per mow at a flat rate.
An electrician's quote for the lighting work would come from the revolving fund.

decisions.decision: Field usage fee discussion goes on the next agenda once baseball usage data and maintenance and mowing costs are sent in.
Wallace Court lighting to be put on the next agenda for a vote with the full commission present.
Next meeting date to be chosen between the 28th and the 21st; the chair will poll members.
The community room MOU is between the recreation department and the library, not the commission, so the commission does not sign it.
